spec_doc.description: The written spec (path added by the diffs).

coverage_map.description: EVERY subsystem-contract invariant mapped to the red test that verifies it: each {invariant_id, test_name, test_file}.

testing_method.description: The axiomatic/property-based approach + engine used (e.g. fast-check property tests), grounded in method_findings.

uncovered.description: Contract invariants with no red test — MUST be empty.

laws.description: The RED laws, BY ADDRESS (contract-records-by-address-v1). A seat supplies {path, commit}: where the committed law file is. The ENGINE stamps, at seal, from RunDeps.tree_root: blob_sha (git rev-parse <commit>:<path>) and tests (the it/test titles in that blob, in file order). A reviewing seat reads the exact law with `git show <commit>:<path>` and checks it against blob_sha. No patch body is ever model output: gig c1771b13's attester hit the 32,000 output-token cap three times re-typing ~150KB of patches into the retired `diffs` field.

blob_sha.description: engine-stamped at seal; a seat-supplied value that disagrees with git is refused (law_bytes_mismatch)

tests.description: engine-stamped at seal: the it/test titles in the blob, in file order
